stations.sampling: Random per-year sample; random state = 42 + year
stations.locationDefinition: Source groups observations by latitude, longitude and height
stations.aggregation: Observation-weighted; RMSE is pooled across observations
stations.periodScope: Evaluation period is not a claim that all years were temporally held out

shap.interpretation: Model reliance on sampled inputs; not a causal effect

runtime.timingScope: single-row feature slice + predictor.predict(row), excluding model load
runtime.scope: CPU feasibility benchmark, not a deployed-receiver measurement

yearSweep.trainingSelection: First 200000 rows of each annual file
yearSweep.testSelection: Fixed seeded random sample of the same 2011 data
yearSweep.verification: Each displayed record agrees between CSV and JSON
yearSweep.interpretation: Training span and row count increase together; their effects are not isolated

manuscript.scope: Manuscript-reported results; distinct from current workbench experiments
